description: Evaluation suite + single-command runner + documentation and dotfiles. The deterministic ten-check eval (contract floor + scoring + version consistency), the optional model-in-the-loop mode, eval_runner.py, requirements.txt (pinned), .env.example, .gitignore, README.md (layered architecture + 5 themes + threat model + disclaimer), and DEMO_SCRIPT.md (beats 0-4 remapped). Depends on FEAT-001 and FEAT-002 (the eval reuses enrich_sessions, guardrails predicates, and the system prompt). This is the CI/on-stage fallback contract (invariants 4, 6, 7).
steps: Create evaluation/contract_checks.py per design sections 5A/6: build the platform via build_platform(SemanticLayer(sem_dir).schema(), project_root). Checks (each a named function that asserts + prints PASS): #1 test_layer_served (served text contains 'Source Catalog', 'Join Semantics', 'session_id'); #2 test_sources_loadable (for every id in platform.list_source_ids(), read_rows(id) is a non-empty list, not a SourceError); #3 test_enrichment_joins (S06 -> 'AI & Agents', 'Workshop Room C', 'Sam Okoye', partial=False); #4 test_partial_flagged (S10 partial=True, 'TBD' in room_name); #10 test_version_consistent (for each of sources.md/field_map.md/joins.md extract the version via regex `#\s*version:\s*(\S+)` group 1 and assert it equals str(schema.json['version']) — do NOT use a naive split). Expose run_all() calling all five.

Create evaluation/scoring.py per design sections 5A/6/3.1: #5 test_prompt_carries_no_structure (import concierge.agent.SYSTEM_PROMPT; assert none of FORBIDDEN=[sessions,tracks,speakers,rooms,track_id,room_id,session_id] match as \b-bounded whole words, case-insensitive, over the lowercased prompt); #6 test_scoring_rejects_missing_citation; #7 test_scoring_rejects_hidden_partial; #8 test_scoring_rejects_invented_value; #9 test_scoring_passes_good_answer — the four scoring checks use orchestration.guardrails predicates over enrich_sessions output + fixed synthetic candidate answers, each returning 0/1, no model/network. Expose run_all() that runs all five and prints a total score.

Create evaluation/model_in_the_loop.py per design section 5A as the OPTIONAL mode behind eval_runner.py --model: calls build_agent() for a live answer and scores it with the same guardrails predicates. Never imported by the deterministic path. evaluation/__init__.py present.

Create eval_runner.py at project root per design section 6: insert its own dir on sys.path, argparse with --model flag, call contract_checks.run_all() then scoring.run_all(); if --model import model_in_the_loop and run; print 'All eval checks passed.'.

Create requirements.txt pinned to strands-agents==1.58.1 and strands-agents-tools==0.8.9 (latest-known-good verified on PyPI during planning; design section 7.2 placeholders updated). Create .env.example per design section 7.3 (AWS_REGION, BEDROCK_MODEL_ID with the verify note, INPUT_COST_PER_1K, OUTPUT_COST_PER_1K). Create .gitignore per design section 7.4 (.env, __pycache__/, *.pyc, .venv/, venv/).

Create README.md per FR-11 / design section 7D: layered-architecture description with an ASCII or mermaid diagram that mirrors the package tree (concierge -> orchestration -> {semantic, data_platform} -> observability leaf), map each of the five themes (eval+scoring, observability, cost-perf, security, modularity) to where it lives in code, tell the reusable-data-platform story (new-connector walk-through from design section 2.2), include a threat model covering prompt injection (tool output as data) and data leakage (least-privilege read-only tools, catalog-gated ids, path confinement), setup/usage, how to run the eval, and the educational/synthetic/fictional disclaimer. Use direct 'what IS needed' phrasing — no 'X not required, but...' framing. Note the one deliberate prompt change vs the reference (dropped the explicit key list).

Create DEMO_SCRIPT.md per design section 9: carry beats 0-4 narration from the reference verbatim, remap paths to the layered tree (Beat 0 four packages 'tree is the diagram'; Beat 1 concierge/agent.py SYSTEM_PROMPT + the structure scan; Beat 2 semantic/*.md + schema.json; Beat 3 python main.py default question + the 'Where is the Future of Open Source panel?' S10 TBD moment, fallback python eval_runner.py; Beat 4 data-only edit of data/tracks.csv + data/sessions.csv re-run). Include the exact Beat-1 structure-scan commands for BOTH PowerShell (Select-String) and macOS/Linux (grep -iE) with an UNESCAPED pipe 'track_id|room_id|sessions', run twice (positive control against semantic/joins.md, then proof against concierge/agent.py), plus the OS-command note up top and the eval-score/layer-version beat.
acceptance_criteria: Deterministic eval passes with NO model and NO network: `python eval_runner.py` from the project dir prints all ten checks PASS and 'All eval checks passed.' with exit code 0, importing only stdlib + project modules.
Absolute-path form of the eval also passes (design section 6 Windows form).
The full import chain (orchestration.tools, orchestration.enrichment, evaluation.contract_checks, evaluation.scoring) imports with strands uninstalled.

Beat-1 structure scan is live: the pattern matches semantic/joins.md (positive control) and returns nothing against concierge/agent.py (proof); the DEMO_SCRIPT ships the pattern with an unescaped pipe.
requirements.txt pins both SDK packages with ==; .env.example and .gitignore present; README carries the disclaimer and a threat model.
verification: cd "c:\Users\evaleah\amazon.com\AWE RTP - Documents\2026 All Things Open\poc-to-prod-demo"; python eval_runner.py   # expect all ten checks PASS + 'All eval checks passed.', exit 0
python "c:\Users\evaleah\amazon.com\AWE RTP - Documents\2026 All Things Open\poc-to-prod-demo\eval_runner.py"   # absolute-path form, same result
python -c "import sys; sys.modules['strands']=None; import orchestration.tools, orchestration.enrichment, evaluation.contract_checks, evaluation.scoring; print('import ok')"

Select-String -Path semantic/joins.md -Pattern 'track_id|room_id|sessions'   # MUST match (positive control); then: Select-String -Path concierge/agent.py -Pattern 'track_id|room_id|sessions'   # MUST return nothing (proof)

python -c "import ast; ast.parse(open('main.py').read()); r=open('requirements.txt').read(); assert '==' in r and 'strands-agents' in r; import os; assert os.path.exists('.env.example') and os.path.exists('.gitignore'); print('docs/dotfiles ok')"
findings:
All five FEAT-003 verification commands pass. `python eval_runner.py` prints all ten checks PASS (#1-#4 contract floor + #10 version guard from contract_checks, then #5-#9 scoring) + 'Scoring: 5/5 checks passed.' + 'All eval checks passed.', exit 0, NO model/NO network. Absolute-path form identical result. Import chain (orchestration.tools, orchestration.enrichment, evaluation.contract_checks, evaluation.scoring) imports with strands uninstalled (sys.modules['strands']=None) -> 'import ok'. Structure scan is LIVE with an unescaped pipe: Select-String 'track_id|room_id|sessions' matches 3 lines in semantic/joins.md (positive control) and 0 lines in concierge/agent.py (proof). docs/dotfiles check passes (main.py parses, requirements.txt has '==' + 'strands-agents', .env.example + .gitignore exist). `python eval_runner.py --model` degrades gracefully: prints 'SKIP model-in-the-loop: agent could not be built (No module named 'strands')' and still exits 0 (deterministic checks unaffected).

FILES CREATED (all top-level under project root):
- evaluation/contract_checks.py: checks #1 test_layer_served (served text has 'Source Catalog'/'Join Semantics'/'session_id'), #2 test_sources_loadable (every id in platform.list_source_ids() -> read_rows is a non-empty list, not SourceError), #3 test_enrichment_joins (S06 -> 'AI & Agents' / 'Workshop Room C' / 'Sam Okoye' / partial=False), #4 test_partial_flagged (S10 partial=True, 'TBD' in room_name), #10 test_version_consistent (regex `#\s*version:\s*(\S+)` group 1 per sources.md/field_map.md/joins.md == str(schema.json['version']); NOT a naive split, so sources.md's trailing prose is ignored). Platform built via build_platform(SemanticLayer(sem_dir).schema(), project_root) and enrich_sessions reused verbatim (no second copy of join logic). run_all() runs all five.
- evaluation/scoring.py: #5 test_prompt_carries_no_structure (imports concierge.agent.SYSTEM_PROMPT; FORBIDDEN=[sessions,tracks,speakers,rooms,track_id,room_id,session_id] scanned as \b-bounded whole words, case-insensitive, over lowercased prompt); #6 test_scoring_rejects_missing_citation (cites_sources False on a no-source-word answer); #7 test_scoring_rejects_hidden_partial (flags_partials False on an answer stating S10's room without TBD); #8 test_scoring_rejects_invented_value (invents_nothing False on an answer naming 'Grand Ballroom' sentinel); #9 test_scoring_passes_good_answer (all three predicates True on a correct cited + TBD answer built from the real enrichment). Each returns 0/1; run_all() prints 'Scoring: N/5 checks passed.' and asserts a perfect score. No model/network -- candidate answers are hard-coded fixtures.
- evaluation/model_in_the_loop.py: OPTIONAL --model mode. build_agent() for a live answer, scored with the same cites_sources/flags_partials/invents_nothing predicates. Never imported by the deterministic path; build/runtime failures print SKIP, never raise past the runner.
- evaluation/__init__.py: package docstring.
- eval_runner.py (project root): inserts its own dir on sys.path; argparse --model; contract_checks.run_all() then scoring.run_all(); --model imports+runs model_in_the_loop; prints 'All eval checks passed.'.
- requirements.txt: strands-agents==1.58.1 / strands-agents-tools==0.8.9 (the planned pins from context.json/FEAT-003, verified during planning).
- .env.example: AWS_REGION, BEDROCK_MODEL_ID (with the verify-at-build-time note), INPUT_COST_PER_1K, OUTPUT_COST_PER_1K (design 7.3).
- .gitignore: .env, __pycache__/, *.pyc, .venv/, venv/ (design 7.4) + build.log (carried from FEAT-001).
- README.md: layered-architecture ASCII diagram mirroring concierge -> orchestration -> {semantic, data_platform} -> observability leaf + the package tree; five themes mapped to code; reusable-data-platform story with the SQLite new-connector walk-through (design 2.2); threat model (prompt injection = tool output as data, never instructions; data leakage = least-privilege read-only tools, catalog-gated ids, path confinement); setup/usage; how to run the eval; educational/synthetic/fictional DevConf 2026 disclaimer; a note on the one deliberate prompt change vs the reference (dropped the explicit key list). Direct 'what IS needed' phrasing throughout.
- DEMO_SCRIPT.md: beats 0-4 narration carried from the reference, remapped to the layered tree (Beat 0 four packages 'tree is the diagram'; Beat 1 concierge/agent.py SYSTEM_PROMPT + the structure scan in BOTH PowerShell Select-String and macOS/Linux grep -iE forms with an UNESCAPED 'track_id|room_id|sessions' pipe, run twice = positive control vs semantic/joins.md then proof vs concierge/agent.py, with the escaping note; Beat 2 semantic/*.md + schema.json; Beat 3 python main.py default question + the S10 'Where is the Future of Open Source panel?' TBD moment, fallback python eval_runner.py; Beat 4 data-only edit of data/tracks.csv + data/sessions.csv). OS-command note up top; optional eval-score/layer-version observability beat.

DEVIATIONS: none from the design. The scoring candidate answers are fixtures chosen to exercise each guardrail predicate's exact semantics (e.g. #6's answer deliberately contains none of track/room/speaker/session/talk so cites_sources returns False). .gitignore keeps build.log in addition to the design 7.4 set (carried from FEAT-001; harmless superset).
